question: Should the 60-publish quota apply to the host-bound widget connection across iframe reloads, or intentionally reset for every newly created iframe bridge?
rationale: This determines the permanent abuse boundary exposed to untrusted agent-authored widgets; tests cannot decide whether reload-scoped quota renewal is acceptable product policy.

options.title: Persist quota across reloads
options.body: Own rate accounting in the host or bus connection so an iframe reload cannot renew the widget's allowance.

options.title: Allow reload-scoped quotas
options.body: Document and explicitly accept that a widget may regain its allowance by reloading its frame.

recommendation.title: Persist quota across reloads
recommendation.body: Own rate accounting in the host or bus connection so an iframe reload cannot renew the widget's allowance.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Workspaces implementation and its sandboxed-widget security boundary were introduced through their merged foundation work.
